scheme_name: Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana
description:
Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana is a significant welfare scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat. 

The scheme was initiated on 1st January 2021. 

It aims to promote inter-caste marriages in the state of Gujarat. 

The initiative is named after Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar, who is recognized for her contributions to social justice and equality. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to encourage couples from different castes to marry. 

This is aimed at reducing caste-based discrimination and promoting social harmony. 

The government seeks to provide financial assistance to couples who marry outside their caste. 

The financial assistance under this scheme is set at ₹2,50,000. 

This amount is provided to the couple as a one-time grant. 

The scheme specifically targets couples who belong to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. 

It also includes couples from Other Backward Classes and the General category. 

The eligibility criteria for the scheme are clearly defined. 

Both partners in the marriage must be residents of Gujarat. 

The age limit for the male partner is set at a minimum of 21 years. 

For the female partner, the minimum age is set at 18 years. 

The couple must provide proof of their inter-caste marriage. 

This proof can be in the form of a marriage certificate issued by the relevant authorities. 

The couple must also provide their Aadhaar cards as proof of identity. 

Additionally, they must submit their income certificates. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹2,50,000 per annum for the couple. 

This ensures that the financial assistance is directed towards those who genuinely need it. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Couples must visit the official website of the Gujarat government. 

They can download the application form from the website. 

The completed application form must be submitted to the local district office. 

Along with the application form, the couple must attach the required documents. 

These documents include the marriage certificate, Aadhaar cards, and income certificates. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes around 30 days. 

If the application is approved, the financial assistance is disbursed. 

The funds are transferred directly to the bank account of the couple. 

The scheme also aims to create awareness about the benefits of inter-caste marriages. 

Workshops and seminars are organized to educate the public. 

These initiatives are designed to change societal attitudes towards inter-caste marriages. 

The government collaborates with various NGOs to promote the scheme. 

The implementation of the scheme is overseen by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

This department is responsible for ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The scheme has been positively received by the public. 

As of October 2023, thousands of couples have benefited from the financial assistance. 

The government has reported an increase in the number of inter-caste marriages since the launch of the scheme. 

This indicates a gradual shift in societal norms regarding caste. 

The scheme also aims to empower women by providing them with financial support. 

Women are often at a disadvantage in traditional marriages. 

By encouraging inter-caste marriages, the scheme promotes gender equality. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 crore for the scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This budget is expected to cover the financial assistance for around 20,000 couples. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote social justice in Gujarat. 

It aligns with the government's commitment to eradicate caste-based discrimination. 

The success of the scheme is measured by the number of applications received. 

The government regularly reviews the implementation of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the process. 

The scheme is also promoted through social media campaigns. 

These campaigns aim to reach a wider audience and encourage participation. 

The government has established a helpline for inquiries related to the scheme. 

The helpline number is available on the official website. 

This ensures that couples can easily access information and assistance. 

The scheme has been recognized as a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

It highlights the importance of government intervention in social issues. 

The promotion of inter-caste marriages is seen as a step towards a more inclusive society. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also fosters social change. 

It encourages dialogue and understanding between different communities. 

The government continues to monitor the impact of the scheme on society. 

Regular reports are published to assess its effectiveness. 

The Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana is a landmark initiative. 

It represents the government's commitment to promoting equality and social justice. 

As more couples take advantage of this scheme, it is expected to contribute to a more harmonious society. 

The initiative serves as a reminder of the importance of unity in diversity. 

Overall, the scheme reflects a progressive approach to addressing caste issues in India. 

It is a significant step towards building a more equitable society for future generations.
